views.text: A modern APT package manager frontend for iOS 15 and higher.

views.markdown:
Support
Need help, want to report a bug, or have a request?
  • Email: korboybeats@gmail.com
  • Discord: korboybeats

New in 2.5.6-1
  • Small bug fix
New in 2.5.6
  • RootHide support with Rootless-to-RootHide package conversion inside Sileo
  • RootHide includes RootHide, Rootless, and Rootful modes
  • RootHide package rows display architecture and conversion labels underneath package icons
  • Added sort by URL functionality for Sources tab
  • Added sort by Installed Packages for Sources tab
  • Show Package Count now applies immediately without restarting Sileo
  • Installed package count is shown automatically when sorting sources by Installed Packages
  • Improved broken-source detection and grouped dead-source alerts
  • Persistent source refresh errors with red errored repo rows and long-press error details
  • Fixed duplicate packages showing the wrong installed source
  • Fixed pasted source batch-add across rootless and rootful source lists
  • Search tab now shows packages from every repo that hosts them
  • Improved package icon loading reliability so repo icons are less likely to fall back to category icons
  • Faster startup when opening directly to Packages or Sources, with repo icons loading from cache instead of refetching every launch
  • Bug fixes and stability improvements
New in 2.5.5
  • Cross-architecture browsing - browse and install rootful packages on rootless jailbreaks
  • Rootful-to-rootless package conversion with live progress log
  • Translate package descriptions using OpenAI, Gemini, DeepL, or MyMemory
  • Search packages by description
  • Dead repo detection - prompt to remove repos that fail multiple refreshes in a row
  • Source refresh up to 2x faster with smart caching (If-Modified-Since)
  • Faster app launch - tabs load on demand, no startup hang
  • Favorite sources - swipe right on a repo to pin it to the top
  • Show Source Count toggle - display repo count in Sources title
  • Default Tab setting in preferences
  • Copy button in the refresh error log
  • Package parsing ~3x faster
  • Korean, Japanese, Chinese, and Hungarian localizations
  • Bug fixes and stability improvements
New in 2.5.4
  • Repo refresh performance improvements (~3x faster)
  • Total progress bar during repo refresh
  • Tap Featured, New, and Sources tabs to scroll to top
  • Settings redesign with collapsible menus
  • Ignored Keywords UI redesign
  • Reinstall swipe action for installed packages
  • Copy DEB URL swipe action
  • Download DEB now works for locally installed packages (repackaging)
  • Tab Haptics toggle in Settings
  • Sort mode applies immediately for installed packages
  • Fiona compatibility fix
  • Various bug fixes and Swift 6 compliance
New in 2.5.3-1
  • Fixed respring prompt not appearing after installing tweaks
New in 2.5.3
  • Enable/Disable Filter Toggle
  • Delete All Keywords option
  • Include Description Toggle
New in 2.5.2
  • Sources Search Bar - search repos by name or URL
  • Download DEB swipe action
  • Ignored Keywords - filter out packages
  • Edit Ignored Keywords
  • Clean Repos - scan and remove dead repositories
